query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

messages.content: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

message.content:
In Massachusetts, the **maximum weekly unemployment benefit** is **$1,105 per week**, and you can receive it for **up to 30 weeks** if you qualify.[2][4]

Your actual weekly amount is usually about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at that maximum.[4] The total you can collect in a benefit year is also limited to **30 times your weekly benefit amount** or **36% of your total wages in the base period**, whichever applies under the state formula.[4]

If you want, I can also calculate your **estimated weekly benefit** and **total possible unemployment amount** based on your wages.
